headline: FG to produce six million passports yearly, eyes ECOWAS market
summary: Interior Minister Tunji-Ojo says Nigeria will produce six million passport booklets yearly by May 2027 and plans to export them to other African countries, targeting the ECOWAS market.
why: Passport production is a state printing and services business, and export plans signal Nigeria's push to sell government services and security-document capacity within West Africa.
